comment: NewItems: a perk and a buff of its own (kiln.gamedata clones). Frostbite is a copy of the Poisoned debuff (0x5f425faf) with its own name, description and a longer duration; Frostbite Edge is a copy of the T2 'poison on hit' perk (its 5% chance, its tooltip) that applies Frostbite instead and runs this mod's own program (impact/frostbite_edge.kimp): the vanilla program's weapon check only lets daggers through, so on a sword it never fires. A perk works once it is unlocked: Items.Give's Epic Glacier has all its enhancements, a crafted one unlocks them at the upgrade table. Glacier carries the perk in its third slot (set in NewItemsMod.cs, where both exist). Fixed GUIDs: ids (FNV-1a of the GUID) stay the same across restarts, so saved items and buffs keep them; if the mod goes away they become inert '[Missing: ...]' placeholders.
